stage_contract.purpose: Freeze a leakage-resistant session, label, split, and independent-holdout contract for authoritative MI48 data.
stage_contract.core_question: Can subject, session, recording, and label provenance be trusted sufficiently to create group-isolated roles and seal an independent holdout?
stage_contract.required_predecessor: B6R-1 full accounting with an identified MI48 schema family and usable frame/metadata evidence.
allowed_inputs: read-only historical T-A5 split and holdout evidence
read-only current source availability and file-stat checks
forbidden_inputs: unresolved archives promoted to MI48 by filename or geometry guess
synthetic examples represented as physical MI48 data
historical REAL_EVAL_DEVELOPMENT relabeled as an independent holdout
required_validation_if_entry_passes: one group in exactly one role
stage_contract.next_stage_condition: B6R-2 group isolation and holdout-seal gate PASS before B6R-3.

failed_conditions: Authoritative MI48 source identity is unresolved and the documented external snapshot is not mounted.
No eligible MI48 frame or supported schema family is available for B6R-2.
Subject/session/recording identities and trustworthy label provenance are absent.
No pristine independent holdout exists; REAL_EVAL_DEVELOPMENT was previously accessed for development.
The B6R-1 standalone validator currently reports 10 generated-artifact checksum mismatches in this checkout.

execution_decision.reason: Creating any split or holdout contract would require guessing MI48 identity, grouping, or labels and would violate the B6R-2 entry gate.

unblock_requirements: Materialize the owner-authorized RP-X0_O2.6_MI48_FIELD_SNAPSHOT or an explicitly approved replacement as read-only input.
Rerun B6R-1 to obtain supported schema, full file/frame accounting, pixel statistics, and metadata provenance.
Resolve the current B6R-1 checksum-validation mismatch without rewriting historical evidence in this B6R-2 stage.
Provide trustworthy subject/session/recording and label provenance or approve a new acquisition plan.
Provide an independent holdout that has not been used for preprocessing, selection, thresholding, or temporal tuning.
